title: Predict: static let Is Lazy
hints: `static let` properties are initialised lazily, on first access, exactly once.
jsBridge: Global and `static let` values are initialised lazily on first access, and atomically (via `dispatch_once`-style guarantees). JS module-level constants run eagerly when the module loads.
